text: DELHI POLICE STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/ 63 /2025 BASIC TRAINING FOR RECRUIT HEAD CONSTABLE (ASSISTANT WIRELESS OPERATOR/TELE-PRINTER OPERATOR) I. INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Head Constable (Assistant Wireless Operator/Tele-Printer Operator) of Communication in Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently and also to inculcate into them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technology. Besides, subjects of professional trade and Outdoor activities Drill Parade and PT, etc., Indoor subjects, such as Police and Society, Police Administration and day-to-day police working have been included in the training course to improve their knowledge of day-to-day wireless equipment etc. Il. OBJECTIVES The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To improve physical strength/resilience. (ii) To give extensive theoretical knowledge and intensive practical training in their trade so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. Ill. DURATION The Six months (06) period of basic training of Head Constable (Assistant Wireless Operator/Tele-Printer Operator) shall be as follows: - SI. No. | Training Period 6 months 1. Basic Training, DPA, Jharoda Kalan | 15 Weeks Residential) (3 “2 months approx.) | 2. Practical Training in District/Unit | 11 Weeks (2 % months) Control Rooms (Non-Residential) Iv. JOINING PERIOD i) All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director or Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. ii) The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. Vv. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently & effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. VI. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be in two folds i.e. "Outdoor' aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; "Indoor' and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills set of the Subject/Trades and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Deputy Director, DPA will be the overall In-charge of Training at DPA. The schedule for Basic Training, syllabus of Outdoor Training/examination, Indoor Training/examination is as at Annexure-I, II & HI respectively. A. OUTDOOR TRAINING The Outdoor training shall be supervised by the Assistant Director, DPA who will be the In-charge Outdoor training assisted by the Chief Drill Instructor (CDI), DPA. i) The training in outdoors shall be in accordance with the principle laid

OUTDOOR TRAINING The Outdoor training shall be supervised by the Assistant Director, DPA who will be the In-charge Outdoor training assisted by the Chief Drill Instructor (CDI), DPA. i) The training in outdoors shall be in accordance with the principle laid down in the Police Manual prescribed from time to time. ii) The Chief Drill Instructor will issue weekly program after obtaining approval of Assistant Director, Outdoor. iii) The daily duration/schedule of the outdoor training shall be as follows: - Day Time |Period | Activity Duration Morning 1 P.T. 40 Minutes 2 Drill/ Parade, Weapon| 40 Minutes (10 minutes | Tactics & Training break in-between) 3 Yoga, Crowd Control,| 40 Minutes Traffic Control Evening _|Games/Gym/UAC 60 Minutes Details of Outdoor subjects, periods & marks are given at Annexure-II. iv) v) In order to ensure effective training and proper supervision over the outdoor training, the trainees shall be divided into platoons of not more than 30 trainees, each under the command of a drill instructor as the platoon commander. He will be responsible for the maintenance of discipline and the general conduct of all the trainees of his squad. He will also ensure cleanliness of rooms and barracks under occupation by his trainees. Team games will also form a regular part of outdoor training schedule. B. INDOOR TRAINING Indoor training shall be supervised by the ACP/Training, Communication, assisted by the I/C Training, Communication. The syllabus of Police Wireless Operator Grade-III (Course Code: PWO-III) for indoor training approved by the ‘Directorate of Coordination Police Wireless’ (DCPW) (MHA) as enclosed at Annexure-IIl. (i) (ii) (iii) (iv) {v) (vi) The training will be conducted according to the prescribed syllabus for which regular weekly time-table will be drawn. The main emphasis of the training will be on practical aspects of the trade. It will be the responsibility of DCP/Communication to ensure that the Instructional Staff is well conversant with their subjects and are able to impart learning to the trainees. The selection of Instructional Staff for teaching trade related to the aspects will be finalized by a committee headed by Joint CP/Operations. There will be 06 indoor periods (04 Theory and 02 Practical) per working day, each period will be of 45 minutes duration & the indoor classes will run from 10:00 AM to 3:30 PM with a recess of 60 minutes duration. The training courses will be conducted in English/Hindi medium for all candidates and they will have to learn and pass the tests or examination in English/ Hindi. They will also be given training in basic knowledge of criminal laws and procedure, practical police work, human right etc. Details of Indoor Subjects along with Periods & Marks are given at Annexure-IIl. VII. STUDY MATERIAL The Joint CP/Operations will constitute a Committee under the Chairmanship of DCP/Communication in order to prepare comprehensive study material. The same shall be made available in the Library of Delhi Police Academy along with nominated faculty decided by the said Committee. Digital content available on e-Ustaad of BPR&D, Knowledge Management System, i-Got Karamyogi and Delhi Police website/ Nipun may also be part of training material. VIII. GUIDANCE AND PROGRESS OF INDIVIDUAL TRAINEES For effective supervision, the trainees shall be sub-divided amongst Inspectors and Sub-Inspectors to be designated as “Course Guide” who shall be responsible for providing in-depth personal guidance to each trainee and the continuous supervision of progress in work, discipline and all-round conduct. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An Assessment of each trainee shall be done by the In- charge/Training, Communication and CLI, DPA with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training (DPA/JK) must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that he/she is brought to the desired level. IX. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES Ninety (90) percent attendance in Outdoor and Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which he or she will be debarred from appearing in the examination. Ten percent relaxation in attendance may be given by Director or Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re-batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice and no further opportunity will be given. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. No leave should be granted during this period and only under in exceptional circumstances it can be granted with prior approval of the Deputy Director. X. DISCIPLINE During basic training at Delhi Police Academy, the trainees shall be deemed to be under the administrative control of the Director or Joint Director, DPA, JK for all intent and purposes. XI. EXAMINATION The assessment of the trainee will be conducted in the form of Periodical Examination & Final Examination including the guidelines issued by DCPW (MHA) as under: - A. XII. HONOUR LIST The trainees will be eligible for the following awards for obtaining outstanding merit in various subjects at the occasion of the "Oath taking Ceremony’ by Director or Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy: - 1. | All Round Best Commendation Certificate with a cash Reward of Rs. 5,000/- 2. | First in Indoor Commendation Certificate with a cash Reward of Rs. 3,000/- 3. | First in Outdoor | Commendation Certificate with a cash Reward of Rs. 3,000/- In case the number of trainees is up to 15, then only 01 prize mentioned at Sl. No.1 will be given. If the number of trainees is above 15, then prize mentioned at Sl. No.1, 2 & 3 will be given. An entry to this effect will be made in the Service Book of the individual and updated in the Intra-DP record also. XII. ATTESTATION PARADE On the completion of course, an ‘Oath-Taking Ceremony’ or ‘Attestation Parade’ will be held for the successful candidates. However, no trainees shall be sent to the Communication Unit to which he or she is allocated for withdrawal of pay or for any other purpose whatsoever, unless he or she has successfully completed the training and has passed out of Delhi Police Academy. XIV. CAUTION While the trainee is undergoing the basic training course, Director or Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy shall be the competent authority for initiating and finalizing disciplinary action against the trainee. He shall also be the competent authority to pass an order regarding termination of services of the trainee under the CCS (Temporary Services) Rules, 1965 & the Delhi Police (Punishment & Appeal) Rules, 1980. In order to eliminate any unsuitable trainee from the force at the stage of his or her training itself, any one of the following grounds shall be sufficient for termination of services: - a) Frequent absence of the trainee from Outdoor or Indoor course leading to a conclusion that he or she is an un-devoted trainee and a 6 habitual absentee, not likely to render satisfactory services to the organization in future. b) Submission of false

MEDICAL CONDITION/HEALTH STATUS & AGE FACTOR i. Women trainee who is pregnant will not be allowed to join training. Women trainees who are incapacitated on account of pregnancy during training will be re-batched immediately. She will be directed to proceed on leave without pay and will be allowed to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch or within 2 years. ii. Trainee suffering from serious ailments or diseases or who had sustained a physical injury resulting in a medical disability before joining the training or during training, such cases will be considered for appropriate remedy and facilitation i.e. writer or translator etc. with the approval of the Deputy Director, Delhi Police Academy on the recommendation of the Assistant Director, Training. XVI. DRESS CODE FOR TRAINING The dress code of trainees for P.T., Drill, Indoor Classes, Sports, General Parade, Practical Training for summer and winter as well as for the attestation- cum-passing out parade shall be specified by the Director or Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Any specific relaxation on genuine grounds shall be under approval of Director or Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. XVII. INTER-SE-SENIORITY The Inter se-seniority shall be fixed as per the provision of Rule - 22 of Delhi Police (Appointment & Recruitment) Rules, 1980. 7 XVIII. REPRESENTATION No representation with regard to result of any examination will be entertained after 30 days of the declaration of the result. XIX. RELAXATIONS The Commissioner of Police, Delhi may relax any conditions laid down in this Standing Order, as per the requirement from time-to-time. XX. text: STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/36 /2025 BASIC TRAINING OF SUB-INSPECTORS (COMPUTER) OF DELHI POLICE (Duration 05+01 Months) I. INTRODUCTION This Standing Order lays down guidelines for imparting Basic Training to directly recruited Sub- Inspector (Computer) of Delhi Police. Sub- Inspector (Computer) possess both the technical expertise in Compute Systems, Cyber security, digital forensics & IT Operations as well as the physical readiness to handle high pressure situations, law enforcement duties and filed operations. They are also required for Law & Order duties on many occasions and should be well equipped with knowledge of relevant Laws and crowd control techniques requiring training in this regard. It outlines the training objectives, content, duration, and evaluation procedures for both indoor and outdoor training modules. Il. OBJECTIVES The object of imparting training to Sub-Inspectors (Computer) is to prepare them to work efficiently by imparting knowledge of various LT. application/functionalities running in Delhi Police. The training will focus on the technical and theoretical knowledge essential for SI(Computer) to perform their duties effectively in I.T environment of Delhi Police. The training will cover data handling/IT applications and the latest technological advancements in law enforcernent. The objective of the training of SI (Computer) is to impart knowledge in the following fields:- A) To make them physically fit and disciplined by training them in Drill, P.T., Parade and weapon training etc. B) To make them well-versed with the I.T. Applications as well as technologies/ functionalities running in Delhi Police. C) To make them well-versed in office procedures, service rules, laws and police administration. D) To impart knowledge of relevant laws, rules and regulations and make them fit to be deployed on law & order duties as and when required. E) To impart theoretical knowledge & practical training in IT environment so that they learn about IT requirements in the force. III. DURATION The duration of the training will be of 05+01 months (i.e. 05 months basic training + Olmonth practical training). Distribution of the Training Days and details thereof is placed at Annexure-I. However, the schedule of Training is subject to change/modification in case of an emergency/contingent condition/requirement by the Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. IV. JOINING PERIOD All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 03 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 07 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. The entire batch enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the initial training. V. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. VI. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy is of different folds i.e. i) "Outdoor" aspect for all

It shall be covered through lectures, discussions, seminars, simulated situations and workshops etc. with the help of various instructional/teaching gadgets; iv) Guest faculty shall also be regularly invited. Help from institution/university for imparting training may also be taken to enrich the training with the approval of competent authority; v) There will be 07 Indoor periods and each period will be of 45 minutes duration and the Indoor classes will run from 09:30 AM to 03:45 AM with a recess of 60 minutes duration. Details of the Indoor Subjects, Periods & Marks are given at Annexure - B. wo C) SPECIAL EMPHASIS WILL BE LAID ON FOLLOWING: - (i) COMPUTER APPLICATION IN OFFICE WORK: A very exhaustive training schedule on computer application in office work will be adhered to and all the trainees will be imparted theoretical as well as practical training on computer application in office work. This is necessary to ensure quality and efficiency in day to day office work and to achieve goal of a paper-less office. VII. STUDY MATERIAL The Director/Joint Director, DPA will constitute a committee under the Chairmanship of Deputy Director or an Assistant Director in order to prepare comprehensive study material. The same shall be made available in the Delhi Police Academy Library for the trainees. Digital content, available on Knowledge Management System, e-USTAD-BPR&D, i-Got Karamyogi, NIPUN (e-LMS) & Delhi Police website, CCTNS Application in view of integration of New Criminal Law, 2023 may also be used as training material. VIII. GUIDANCE AND PROGRESS OF INDIVIDUAL TRAINEES The Indoor & Outdoor training shall be supervised by an Assistant Director of Police, who shall be assisted by Chief Law Instructor (CLI) for Indoor Training and Chief Drill Instructor (CDI) for Outdoor training separately. The training will be conducted according to the prescribed syllabus for which regular weekly time table prepared by Assistant Director/Indoor under the supervision of Dy. Director/DPA will be issued after approval of the Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. It will be the responsibility of the Director/Joint Director to ensure that the Indoor Faculty is well conversant with their subjects and are able to teach the trainees ensuring that they imbibe the instructions and make satisfactory progress. Since a great responsibility rest on Faculty, their selection shall be made by the Director/Joint Director, who is overall in- charge of the DPA. The Director/Joint Director, DPA and Assistant Director/Training will exercise close supervision over the training activities ensuring that recruits are fully and comprehensively trained. The Director/Joint Director/Deputy Director/DPA on the recommendations of the ADs/ Training will also arrange for officers from other units to be invited as guest faculty to deliver lecture or give demonstration on topics of professional interest.

IX. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVE A total of 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory failing which she/he will be debarred from appearing in the examination. Trainees having 75% or more but less than 90% attendance will be allowed to appear in the examination after undergoing extra classes for one month. However, trainees having less than 75% attendance will be re-batched and will be 4 directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re- batched only twice; no further opportunity will be given there after & her/his services will be terminated by the competent authority under Rule 5 of the Central Civil Services (Temporary service) Rules, 1965. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. No leave should be granted during this period and only under exceptional circumstances, it may be sanctioned with prior approval of Deputy Director. X. DISCIPLINE During basic training at Delhi Police Academy, the trainees shall be deemed to be under the administrative control of Director/Joint Director for all intent and purposes. XI. EXAMINATIONS The progress of the trainee will be assessed through mid-term exam. Jt. Director/ Delhi Police Academy will carefully scrutinize performance of trainees in these tests and in cases, where it is found that any trainee is unable to imbibe the training imparted and is not likely to become a good officer, he will take suitable remedial action. A trainee shall not be allowed to appear in final examination until and unless he/she has successfully undergone a stipulated period of training at Delhi Police Academy. At least 90% attendance in Indoor/Outdoor period is compulsory failing which he/she will be debarred from appearing in the final examination. Such trainee will be re-batched and will join the training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice, no further opportunity will be given. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the fixed date of joining training of the Batch. On completion of their basic training course, the trainees shall be examined by a Board of Examiners to be constituted by the Director/Delhi Police Academy, Delhi on the request of the Joint Director or Deputy Director, Delhi Police Academy. The Board shall be chaired by an officer of the rank of Jt. Director or Deputy Director, Delhi Police Academy with Asstt. Directors/Delhi Police

The details of attachment as under:- a) One week at Computer Centre/Traffic (HQ). b) One week at Crime (CCTNS, Data Centre/SCRB & Research Cell) c) One Week at IT Centre, PHQ & Safe City Project, PHQ. d) One Week at IFSO (Special Cell). XIV. ATTESTATION PARADE An attestation-cum-passing out parade, including “Oath-taking ceremony" of the trainees shall be conducted who pass the final examination. Those, who do not qualify in examination will not be allowed to participate in the attestation-cum-passing out parade. If they pass in the 02 additional chances given, they will be administered oath and allowed to pass out of Delhi Police Academy. No passing out parade would be held for such individuals. xX¥. CAUTION While the trainee is undergoing the basic training course, Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy shall be the competent authority for initiating and finalizing disciplinary action against the trainee. He shall also be the competent authority to pass an order regarding termination of services of the trainee under The CCS (Temporary Services) Rules, 1965 & The Delhi Police (Punishment & Appeal) Rules, 1980. In order to eliminate any unsuitable trainee from the force at the stage of her/his training itself, any one of the following grounds shall be sufficient for termination of services: - a) Frequent absence of the trainee from Outdoor/Indoor course leading to a conclusion that she/he is an un-devoted trainee and a habitual absentee, not likely to render satisfactory services to the organization in future. b) Submission of a false information and fake medical Certificate from any doctor for availing leave or light duty or rest. c) A trainee who avails medical rest of exceeding 14 days continuously will have to appear before a medical board for opinion, if required. d) Gross misconduct with Indoor/Outdoor Instructors or with other trainees/ staff. e) Any mischief or any crime involving her/his moral turpitude during the training period. f) If she/he commits any mischief or any crime involving her/his moral turpitude during her/his training. g) If any information submitted by the trainee, which is found to be false, fabricated or manipulated to gain employment. text: STANDING ORDER NO. INT./03/2025 PROCEDURE FOR ISSUANCE OF ONLINE CHARACTER VERIFICATION REPORT (CVR) AND POLICE CLEARANCE CERTIFICATE (PCC) 1. Introduction: Delhi Police shall undertake the following police verification services for the Indian Nationals who are/were residing at address(s) belonging to Delhi: (i) Character Verification Report (CVR) which will be issued on a reference received from Government/Semi Government/ Public Sector organizations to verify the character and antecedents of the applicants who is/are newly selected/appointed as employee(s). It will entail a thorough antecedent and address verification. (ii) Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) which will be of two types: a. PCC- Address and Antecedent’s verification - This PCC will be issued after conducting proper field/ physical verification for both individuals and Firms/Agencies for the following categories of requests/applications: i. PCC for Emigration purpose. ii. PCC Request by a Non-Resident Indian (NRI) applying for his/her period of residency on Delhi. iii. Any Applicant requesting a proof of his/her stay at the given address(s) belonging to any category as mention below. b. PCC - Antecedent’s Verification only-— This PCC will be issued for all categories in which antecedent’s verification is requested. This PCC will not require a visit to the address of the applicant and will entail a record check as per the available databases viz. SCRB, CCTNS, ICJUS and Register No. IX, Part-II of the concerned Police Station. Categories for which police Clearance Certificates will be issued: The above types of Police Clearance Certificate will generally be issued for the following categories: - i) Job purposes- either on the application of the individual or reference received from the employer. ii) Various categories of license (excluding those covered under Arms Act) who apply to Licensing Unit of Delhi Police. iii) Journalists seeking accreditation from PIB and DIP, GNCT, Delhi. iv) Employees of Private Contractors /agencies who have been engaged by Government, Semi-Government, PSU, Defence Forces, Airport Authority, Delhi Metro Rail Corporation etc. v) Agents / companies engaged for post office and any other services to the Government, Semi-government or PSU. (e.g. Gold evaluators engaged by any bank, etc.) vi) Security agencies and / or their directors or their employees applying for licenses under PSARA (Private Security Agency Regulation Act). vii) Registration of Commercial Vehicles. viii) Adoption of Child. ix) Miscellaneous category. The categories mentioned above are subject to change as per the field requirements after approval of DCP/ Special Branch, Delhi. 2. Format of the certificates to be issued: The format of the certificates of CVR and PCC shall be followed as per the following annexures: (i) Annexure A - Format for CVR in clear case (on field enquiry) (ii) Annexure B - Format for CVR in case of criminal involvement (on field enquiry) (iii) Annexure C - Format for PCC in clear case (on field enquiry) (iv) Annexure D - Format for PCC in case of criminal involvement (on field enquiry) (v) Annexure E - Format for PCC in clear case (Without field enquiry) (vi) Annexure F - Format for PCC in case of criminal

text: DING O QO. fi 3/20 DELHI POLICE MARTYRS’ FUND 1. INTRODUCTION The Fund shall be called “Delhi Police Martyrs’ Fund” (hereinafter referred to as the ‘Martyrs’ Fund’ or 'Fund') and shall provide, inter-alia, immediate monetary assistance to the families of its members, who lay down their lives during the course of government duty. A ‘Member’ will be Delhi Police personnel who opts to contribute to the Fund and has not ceased to be a member by declining to contribute when a repeat contribution is sought. ; 2. ‘OBJECTIVE OF THE FUND The object of the Fund is to provide financial assistance to the family of Delhi Police personnel, who contribute to the Fund and are its members, and lay down their lives while performing government duty. This Fund commences its operation w.e.f. 01.02.2013 retrospectively and the benefit under the Fund will be available to its members accordingly. This Fund has been initiated for the benefit of employees of Dethi Police of all ranks and cadres who are its members. Note: (a) The term ‘on duty’ is defined as death which occurs or is caused while an employee is performing government duty, it does not include the journey from home or other place to place of duty or from duty to home or other place. (b) The term ‘gallantry’ means death caused solely and directly by external violence while in the course of duty if a member is killed by criminals or terrorists or anti social elements etc. 3. HRD/62/2025 BASIC TRAINING OF DRAUGHTSMAN INTRODUCTION This Standing Order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Draughtsman in Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally sound to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, discipline, punctuality and social skills. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade etc. In Indoor activities, they will be imparted training wrt subject of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary to improve their knowledge of day-to-day Police requirements in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To inculcate force discipline (ii) | To improve physical Strength; (iii) To impart theoretical knowledge & practical training in their respective trades so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of Draughtsman will be of 02 months. JOINING PERIOD All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year, should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. i) ii) iii) iv) v) TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be two folds viz.:- "Outdoor" aspect for all round physical fitness, strengthening the fibre of discipline and toughening up in general; "Indoor" and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge and Develop skills of the tradecraft. The schedule for basic training, syllabus of | Outdoor Training/examination, Indoor Training/examination is given at Annexures I, II & III, respectively. | S. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An assessment of each trainee shall be done by the Chief Law Instructor (CLI), DPA/JK with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training, DPA JK must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that she/he is brought to the desired level. XI. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which he/she will be debarred from appearing in the examination. 10 % relaxation in attendance may be given by Director/Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re-batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice, no further opportunity will be given. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. No leave should be ordinarily granted during this period and only under exceptional circumstances, it may be sanctioned with prior approval of Deputy Director. DISCIPLINE During basic training at Delhi Police Academy, the trainees shall be deemed to be under the administrative control of Director/Joint Director for all intent and purposes. EXAMINATION The examination of the trainee will be held in the form of Periodical Examination and Final Examination as under: - Periodical Examination One internal test of the respective trade, involving practical work related to their jobs will be conducted after completion of 01 month of training. Maximum 05 marks will be awarded to trainee on the basis of his performance in the monthly test. Final Examination On completion of their basic training course, the trainees shall be examined by a Board of Examiners to be constituted by the Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy, Delhi on the request of Deputy Director, Delhi Police Academy. text: II. I. STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/61/2025 BASIC TRAINING FOR SUB INSPECTOR (STATISTICIAN) (Duration 04+01 Months) INTRODUCTION This Standing Order lay down guidelines for imparting Basic Training of Direct Sub Inspector (Statistician) to acquaint them to have expertise in collection, compilation and preparation of analytical reports of crime data, both timely & accurately. They must also be aware of various statistical softwares, tools and methodologies etc., which are both desirable & essential for statistical analysis. They may also be called for Law & Order duties on various occasions, and therefore should be well equipped with knowledge of relevant laws and crowd control techniques, requiring training to make them efficient, disciplined and courteous Police Officers. OBJECTIVES OF TRAINING The primary objective of imparting training to Sub Inspector (Statistician) is to collect, compile and dissemination of crime statistics, received from various Districts/Units. Research Cell/Crime Branch also provides this information on daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly, half yearly and Annually as and when required for MHA, L&O, Hon’ble LG’s, Interstate, Northern Region and other important meetings/discussions. Research Studies/Analysis (Spatial and time) with respect to various offences like Dacoity/Robbery, Murder, Attempt to Murder Snatching, MV Theft, Crime against Women and Children as well as other offences, etc. are also undertaken from time to time. Research Cell also provides the Crime statistics and brief notes trends on Crime Situation in Delhi, for all the Parliament Questions and various other Commissions/Forums, through PHQ. It also assists the various Coordinating Agencies for Research, Organization and compiling the information for Interstate Co-ordination meetings, maintaining liaison between Delhi Police and other important agencies like: Ministry of Home Affairs, BPR&D, GNCT Delhi, NCRB New Delhi etc. and other outside agencies, by providing all types of information relating to statistics-Crime & Criminals. It also prepares notes along with supporting data for the Research Studies undertaken. DURATION The duration of the training will be of 04+01 months (i.e. 04 months basic training + Ol month practical training). Distribution of the 1 i) ii) A) i) Training Days and details thereof is placed at Annexure-I. However, the schedule of Training is subject to change/modification, in case of any emergency/ contingent condition/requirement by the DPA, with the prior approval of Competent Authority. JOINING PERIOD All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 07 working days can be given in exceptional cases, by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Besides, relaxation of 10 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. The entire batch enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the initial training. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties, according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining excellent mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures/Rules. (ELECTRICIAN), MT HELPER (PAINTER) & MT STOREMAN INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Constable - MT Helper (Mechanical), MT Helper (Electrician), MT Helper (Painter) & MT Store-man in Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, discipline, punctuality and social skills. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade, etc. In Indoor activities, they will be imparted training wrt subjects of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary to improve their knowledge of day-to-day police requirements in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES OF TRAINING The objective of their basic training is as follows: - i) To inculcate force discipline ii) To improve physical strength and mental strength iii) To impart theoretical knowledge & practical training in their respective trades so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of Constable - MT Helper (Mechanical), MT Helper (Electrician), MT Helper (Painter) & MT Store-man will be of 06 (Six) months prescribed in notified Recruitment Rules (RRs), as follows: - S. No. | Training Period 1. Basic Training, DPA, JK 02 Months 2. Practical training in their respective trades for their | 04 Months skill development at Provisioning and Logistics Unit. JOINING PERIOD All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day as per the date and time mentioned in their joining letter. However, maximum relaxation of 1 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by the Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training, Delhi. ii) The whole batch of particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. Vv. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. VI. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be two folds i.e. "Outdoor' aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; "Indoor' and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills sets of the subject/Trade and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Deputy Director, DPA will be the overall In-charge of Training at DPA, JK. text: I. Ill. STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/58/2024 BASIC TRAINING OF CONSTABLE (WORKSHOP HAND) INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Constable (Workshop Hand), Communication in Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently with requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technical and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, discipline, punctuality and social skills. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade etc., in Indoor activities, they will be imparted training wrt subjects of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary for becoming a Police officer & to improve their knowledge of day-to-day Police wireless equipment’s etc. in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES OF TRAINING ' The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To inculcate force discipline. (ii) To improve physical strength/resilience. (iii) To give extensive theoretical knowledge and intensive practical training in their trade so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of Constable (Workshop Hand) prescribed in Recruitment Rules (RRs) will be of 03 (Three) months at Delhi Police Academy. JOINING PERIOD (i) All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. a A. (ii) | The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight- forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. TAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be in two folds ie. "Outdoor" aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; "“Indoor’ and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills sets of the subject/Trades and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Dy. Director/DPA will be the overall in-charge of the training. The schedule for Basic Training, syllabus of Outdoor Training/examination, Indoor Training/examination is as at Annexure I, II & If respectively. Outdoor Training The Outdoor training shall be supervised by the Asstt. Director, DPA who will be the In-charge Outdoor training assisted by the Chief Drill Instructor (CDI), DPA. (i) The training in outdoors shall be in accordance with the principle laid down in the Police Manual prescribed from time to time. (ii) |The Chief Drill Instructor will issue weekly

GUIDANCE AND PROGRESS OF INDIVIDUAL TRAINEES For effective supervision, the trainees shall be sub-divided amongst Inspectors/Sub Inspectors to be designated as "Course Guide" who shall be responsible for providing in-depth personal guidance to each trainee and the continuous supervision of progress in work, discipline and all- round conduct. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An Assessment of each trainee shall be done by the In-Charge/Trg./Communication, Delhi 8& CLI, DPA/JK with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training, DPA JK must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that she/he is brought to the desired level. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES (i) 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which she/he will be debarred from appearing in the examination. 10% relaxation in attendance may be given by Director/Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re- batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice and no further opportunity will be given thereafter & her/his services will be terminated by the competent authority under Rule 5 of the Central Civil Services (Temporary service) Rules, 1965. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. (ti) No leave should be granted during this period and only under exceptional circumstances it can be granted with prior approval of the Deputy Director. text: I. Til. STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/57/2024 BASIC TRAINING OF HEAD CONSTABLE (TELEPHONE EXCHANGE OPERATOR) INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Head Constable (Telephone Exchange Operator) in Communication unit of Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently with requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technical and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technical. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade etc., in Indoor activities, they will be imparted training w.r.t. subjects of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary for becoming a Police officer & to improve their knowledge of day-to-day Police wireless equipment’s etc. in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES OF TRAINING The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To inculcate force discipline. (ii) To improve physical strength/resilience. (iii) To give extensive theoretical knowledge and intensive practical training in their trade so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of Head Constable (Telephone Exchange Operator) will be of 09 (nine) months prescribed in notified Recruitment Rules (RRs), as follows: - S. No. Training | Period 1. Basic Training, DPA, JK 15 weeks (3 % months approx.) 2. Practical Training in Telephone | 03 months Exchange 3. Practical Training in Control} 02 % months Rooms Iv. VI. JOINING PERIOD (i) All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. (ii) | The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and. also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be two folds i.e. "Qutdoor' aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; "Indoor’ and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills sets of the subject/Trades and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Deputy Director, DPA will be the overall In-charge of Training at DPA, JK. The schedule for Basic Training, syllabus of Outdoor Training/examination, Indoor Training/examination is as at Annexure J, IT & II respectively. A. GUIDANCE AND PROGRESS OF INDIVIDUAL TRAINEES For effective supervision, the trainees shall be sub-divided amongst Inspectors/Sub Inspectors to be designated as "Course Guide" who shall be responsible for providing in-depth personal guidance to each trainee and the continuous supervision of progress in work, discipline and all- round conduct. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An Assessment of each trainee shall be done by the In-Charge/Trg./Communication, Delhi & CLI, DPA/JK with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training, DPA JK must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that she/he is brought to the desired level. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES (i) 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which she/he will be debarred from appearing in the examination. 10% relaxation in attendance may be given by Director/Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re-batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice and no further opportunity will be given. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. (ii) No leave should be granted during this period and only under exceptional circumstances it can be granted with prior approval of the Deputy Director. text: II. Ti. STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/56/2024 BASIC TRAINING OF HEAD CONSTABLE (STORE-CLERK} INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Head Constable (Store-Clerk) in Communication unit of Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently with requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technical and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, discipline, punctuality and social skills. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade etc., in Indoor activities, they will be imparted training wrt subjects of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary for becoming a Police officer & to improve their knowledge of day-to-day Police wireless equipment’s etc. in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To inculcate force discipline. (ii) | To improve physical strength/ resilience. (iii) To give extensive theoretical knowledge and intensive practical training in their trade so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of Head Constable (Store Clerk) will be of 06 (six) months prescribed in notified Recruitment Rules (RRs), as follows: - S. No. Training Period 1. Basic Training at DPA, JK 15 weeks 2. Practical Training in District/Unit 11 weeks stores of Communication JOINING PERIOD i} All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training, Delhi. ii) The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight- forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be in two folds ie. “Outdoor’ aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; “Indoor’ and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills sets of the subject/Trades and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Deputy Director, DPA will be the overall In-charge of Training at DPA, JK. The schedule for Basic Training, syllabus of Outdoor Training/examination, Indoor Training/examination is as at Annexure J, I & Il respectively. Outdoor Training The Outdoor training shall be supervised by the Asstt. Director, DPA who will be the In-charge Outdoor training assisted by the Chief Drill Instructor (CDI), DPA. i) The training in outdoors shall

GUIDANCE AND PROGRESS OF INDIVIDUAL TRAINEES For effective supervision, the trainees shall be sub-divided amongst Inspectors/Sub Inspectors to be designated as "Course Guide" who shall be responsible for providing in-depth personal guidance to each trainee and the continuous supervision of progress in work, discipline and all- round conduct. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An Assessment of each trainee shall be done by the In-Charge/Trg./Communication, Delhi & CLI, DPA/JK with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training, DPA JK must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that she/he is brought to the desired level. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES i) 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which she/he will be debarred from appearing in the examination. 10% relaxation in attendance may be given by Director/Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re- batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice and no further opportunity will be given thereafter & her/his services will be terminated by the competent authority under Rule 5 of the Central Civil Services (Temporary service) Rules, 1965. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. ii) No leave should be granted during this period and only under exceptional circumstances it can be granted with prior approval of the Deputy Director. ‘ DISCIPLINE During basic training at Delhi Police Academy, the trainees shall be deemed to be under the administrative control of Director /Joint Director for all intent and purposes. HRD/55/2024 BASIC TRAINING OF HEAD CONSTABLE - FITTER (BATTERY), FITTER (ENGINE), FITTER (ELECTRICIAN), DRAFTSMAN (TRACER), MAST LASKER & CARPENTER (COMMUNICATION) INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited Head Constable Fitter (Battery), Fitter (Engine), Fitter (Electrician), Draftsman (Tracer), Mast Lasker, and Carpenter (Communication) in Communication Unit of Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently with requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technical and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, discipline, punctuality and social skills. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade etc., in Indoor activities, they will be imparted training w.r.t subjects of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary for becoming a Police officer & to improve their knowledge of day-to-day Police wireless equipment’s etc. in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES OF TRAINING The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To inculcate force discipline. (ii) | To improve physical strength/ resilience. (iii) To give extensive theoretical knowledge and intensive practical training in their trade so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of Head Constable Fitter (Battery), Fitter (Engine), Fitter (Electrician), Draftsman (Tracer), Mast Lasker, and Carpenter (Communication) will be of O06 (six) months prescribed in Notified Recruitment Rules (RRs), as follows: - S. No. Training Period 1. Basic Training at DPA, JK 15 weeks 2. Practical Training at District/Unit Radio| 11 weeks Workshops VI. JOINING PERIOD (i) All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training. (ii) | The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be in two folds i.e. "Outdoor’ aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; "Indoor" and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills sets of the subject/Trades and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Deputy Director, DPA will be the overall In-charge of Training at DPA, JK. The schedule for Basic Training, syllabus of Outdoor Training/examination, Indoor Training/examination is as at Annexure I, II

He will also ensure cleanliness of rooms and barracks under occupation by his trainees. (v) Team games will also form a regular part of outdoor training schedule. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An Assessment of each trainee shall be done by the In-Charge/Trg./Communication, Delhi & CLI, DPA/JK with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training, DPA JK must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that she/he is brought to the desired level. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES (i) 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which she/he will be debarred from appearing in the examination. 10% relaxation in attendance may be given by Director/Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re-batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice and no further opportunity will be given. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. text: Il. iil. STANDING ORDER NO. HRD/54/2024 BASIC TRAINING OF ASI/SI - RADIO TECHNICIAN INTRODUCTION This standing order provides the guidelines for basic training of newly recruited ASI/SI - Radio Technician in Communication Unit of Delhi Police. The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to discharge their duties according to their trade efficiently with requisite knowledge of Police Wireless Technical and also to inculcate in them, the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, discipline, punctuality and social skills. Besides, Outdoor activities such as Physical Training (PT), Drill, Parade etc., in Indoor activities, they will be imparted training wrt subjects of trade as well as knowledge of Police Organization, Rules & Regulations of Police Department & other such activities necessary for becoming a Police officer & to improve their knowledge of day-to-day Police wireless equipment’s etc. in the interest of goals of Delhi Police. OBJECTIVES OF TRAINING The objective of their basic training is as follows: - (i) To inculcate force discipline. (ii) To improve physical strength/resilience. (iii) To give extensive theoretical knowledge and intensive practical training in their trade so that they learn about its requirements in the force and the manner of doing it in a disciplined organization. DURATION The period of basic training of ASI/SI - Radio Technician will be of 06 (six) months prescribed in notified Recruitment Rules (RRs), as follows:- S. No. | Training Period 1._| Basic Training, DPA, JK 12 weeks 2. | Practical Training in District/Units, Radio 14 weeks Workshops of Communication unit JOINING PERIOD (i) All trainees of a batch will join the training on the same day. However, maximum relaxation of 02 working days can be given in 1 exceptional cases by Director/Joint Director, Delhi Police Academy. Relaxation of 04 days can be given with the approval of Special Commissioner of Police, Training, Delhi. (ii) The whole batch of the particular trade enlisted in a year should undergo training during that year and no one shall be exempted from the basic training. TRAINING NEEDS The purpose of training is to prepare them professionally to perform their duties according to their trade efficiently and effectively and also to inculcate in them the habit of maintaining mental and physical health, hygiene, discipline and punctuality, courtesy, straight-forwardness and requisite knowledge of office and Police procedures. TRAINING ASPECTS The training at Delhi Police Academy shall be in two folds ie. "Outdoor' aspect for all round physical fitness, capacity building, discipline and ability to perform vigorous duties in general; "Indoor and Practical training for imparting professional knowledge, develop skills sets of the subject/Trade and dynamic changes in the field of applied knowledge. Deputy Director, DPA will be the overall In-charge of Training at DPA, JK. The schedule for Basic Training, syllabus of Outdoor Training/ examination, Indoor Training/examination is as at Annexure - I, II & III respectively. A, Outdoor Training The Outdoor training shall be supervised by the Asstt. Director, DPA who will be the In-charge Outdoor training assisted by the Chief Drill Instructor (CDI),

A, Outdoor Training The Outdoor training shall be supervised by the Asstt. Director, DPA who will be the In-charge Outdoor training assisted by the Chief Drill Instructor (CDI), DPA. (i) The training in outdoors shall be in accordance with the principle laid down in the Police Manual prescribed from time to time. (ii) The Chief Drill Instructor will issue weekly program after obtaining approval of Assistant Director, Outdoor. (iii) The daily duration/schedule of the outdoor training shall be as follows: - Day time | Period Activity Duration Morning 1 P.T. 40 Minutes 2 Drill/Parade, Weapon| 40 Minutes | Tactics & Training (10 minutes break in- between) | 3 | Yoga, Crowd Control, | 40 Minutes Traffic Control Evening | Games/Gym/UAC 60 Minutes Details of Outdoor subjects, periods & marks are given at Annexure -II. 2 VII. (iv) In order to ensure effective training and proper supervision over the outdoor training, the trainees shall be divided into platoons of not more than 30 trainees, each under the command of a drill instructor as the platoon commander. He will be responsible for the maintenance of discipline and the general conduct of all the trainees of his squad. He will also ensure cleanliness of rooms and barracks under occupation by his trainees. {v) Team games will also form a regular part of outdoor training schedule. B. Indoor Training Indoor training shall be supervised by the ACP/Trg. /Comn, & AD/Indoor, DPA/JK assisted by the In-Charge Trg. /Comn. & CLI, DPA/JK. (i) The Indoor syllabus will cover General paper wrt Organization & Administration, Police & Society, Law etc. & the subjects of Police Wireless Technical Grade-II (Course Code: PWT-II) as approved by the Directorate Coordination Police Wireless (DCPW) (MHA), as at Annexure - III. (ii) The training will be conducted according to the prescribed syllabus for which regular weekly time-table will be drawn. (iii) The main emphasis of the training will be on practical aspects of the trade. It will be the responsibility of DCP/Communication, Delhi to ensure that the Instructional Staff is well conversant with their subjects and are able to impart learning to the trainees. The selection of Instructional staff for teaching trade related aspects will be finalized by a committee headed by Joint CP/Operations. (iv) There will be 06 indoor periods (04 Theory and 02 Practical) and each period will be of 45 minutes duration & the indoor classes will run from 10:00 AM to 3:30 PM with a recess of 60 minutes duration. (v) The training courses will be conducted in English/Hindi medium for all candidates and they will have to learn and pass the test/examination in English/ Hindi. GUIDANCE AND PROGRESS OF INDIVIDUAL TRAINEES For effective supervision, the trainees shall be sub-divided amongst Inspectors/Sub Inspectors to be designated as "Course Guide" who shall be responsible for providing in-depth personal guidance to each trainee and the continuous supervision of progress in work, discipline and all- round conduct. A weekly interactive session will be conducted by the Course Guides to monitor the progress of the trainees. An Assessment of each trainee shall be done by the In-Charge/Trg. /Communication, Delhi & CLI, DPA/JK with the help of Course Guide to ensure improvement in professional skills. Assistant Director/Training, DPA JK must ensure that the trainees are fully and comprehensively trained in all aspects. In all cases, where it is found that any trainee is lagging behind, special attention shall be paid so that she/he is brought to the desired level. ATTENDANCE AND LEAVES (i) 90% attendance in Outdoor/Indoor periods is compulsory, failing which she/he will be debarred from appearing in the examination. 10% relaxation in attendance may be given by Director/Joint Director, DPA in case of any unavoidable exigency. The trainee who could not achieve the benchmark will be re- batched and be directed to proceed on leave without pay with the directions to join training from the beginning with the next scheduled batch. A trainee will be re-batched only twice and no further opportunity will be given thereafter & her/his services will be terminated by the competent authority under Rule 5 of the Central Civil Services (Temporary service) Rules, 1965. Attendance of a trainee will be counted from the date of joining of training. However, those who join late, their syllabus will be covered by conducting extra classes. (ii) No leave should be granted during this period and only under exceptional circumstances it can be granted with prior approval of the Deputy Director. text: STANDING ORDER NO. Finance/02/2022 ALLOTMENT & FUNCTIONING OF COMMUNITY CENTRES/HALLS — General This Standing Order regulates the allotment and functioning of “Community Centres & Halls” built therein, belonging to Delhi Police (Annexure ‘A’) and utilization of the “Community Centre Allotment Fund’. The object of this Standing Order is to provide temporary allotment of Community Halls, belonging to Delhi Police for the purpose of holding cultural and social functions, marriages and socially healthy activities. Definitions In these rules, unless the context otherwise requires: - (i) “Allotment” means grant of a license to temporarily occupy the Community Hall for marriage and other functions. (ii) The ‘Allotment Officer’ means the Deputy Commissioner of Police of the concerned District/Unit in which the community Hall is situated. (iii) Eligible Relatives’ mean the son, daughter, spouse and dependant sister. Eligibilit Persons falling in the following categories shall only be eligible to apply for booking of the Community Halls: - (i) All serving Delhi Police officers and men. including Class-IV employees or officers on deputation to Delhi Police. (ii) | IPS Officers of AGMU and UTPS Cadre officers in Delhi Police or elsewhere or on deputation to other organization including PSUs. (iii) All civilians on the pay rolls of Delhi Police. (iv) Employees and office bearers of Delhi Police Public School and regular employees of CGHS and DPHCL located in the complex where the Community Centre is situated. (v) All retired Delhi Police personnel. (vi) Eligible relatives of any deceased IPS officers belonging to AGMUT or DANIPS cadres, officers of Delhi Police including Class — IV employees. Administration The Community Centre will be under the administrative control of the Central Managing Committee and Sub-Committee shall be responsible for day to day functioning of the community centers/ halls and maintenance. DCP of the concerned Unit/District shall be the head of the Sub-Committee of the Community Centre Allotment Fund and shall be assisted by ACP/Headquarters of the concerned Unit/District in the administration of the Community Centre, discipline maintenance and up-keep of the Community Centre & Hall. The ACP/Headquarters of the concerned Unit/District shall report to the DCP concerned without delay regarding any damage cause to the Community Centre. He shall be assisted by the Inspector/Estate of the. concerned District/Unit, in the discharge of his duties. Central Managing Committee The Central Community Hall Managing Committee shall be responsible for the entire management of Delhi Police, Community Centres/Halls and shall- deal with all policy matters related to Community Centres/Halls, consisting of the followings:- Jt.CP/Addl. An agenda for the meeting of the Sub-Committee shall be prepared and circulated by the DCP of the. concerned District/Unit of the Sub-Committee to all members at least a fortnight before the date of meeting. Minutes of the Sub-Committee shall be drawn and kept on record in a Minutes Book, for 10 years and will be destroyed only with the prior approval of the President of the Central Managing Committee. A copy of the minutes of every meeting shall be submitted by the Secretary of the Central Managing Committee to the Commissioner of Police, Delhi through the President for approval and only after which action will be taken on the recommendation of the Central Managing Committee. WEB BOOKING FACILITY: An online system checking availability, making booking requests and online payment of hiring charges will start soon through a sub- domain on the main Delhi Police Website. Funds The amount/funds collected through the ‘hiring of Community. Centres/Halls shall be known as “Community Centre Allotment Fund”. All amounts realized on account of Community Centre allotment shall be credited to this fund which shall be saved and maintained in any bank in Delhi (nearest to the Community Centre). This fund.shall be operated by the DCP of the concerned District/Unit subject to the normal rules applicable to Govt. funds and the instructions lay hereunder. The surplus amount of the fund shall be invested in cash certificates, fixed deposits, Govt. securities or any other investment scheme with the approval of Central. Managing Committee. The Accountant of the concerned Unit/District shall maintain .an index register for such deposits under close supervision of ACP/Headquarters of the concerned Unit/ District. How to Apply Every police personnel or public person who desires an allotment of the Community Hall shall submit his/her application through Delhi Police website to the Deputy Commissioner of Police of the concerned District/Unit. The application should be submitted online on Delhi Police 3 12. 13. website at least 10 days before the date of commencement of the function/event and should mention therein, the purpose, duration of allotment and relationship and residential address etc. The Deputy Commissioner of Police of the concerned District/Unit will approve the allotment only when he is satisfied that the Centre/Hall is being booked for purpose of holding cultural or social function, marriage or socially healthy activities. , Period of Allotment The Community Hall on hire basis will be allotted on first come first serve basis for a period not exceeding 48 hours (2 days) for a marriage function, under any circumstance. For other purposes such as indoor games etc. the Community Hall will be allotted only as per availability and necessity. Hiring Charges & Booking ‘The charges for hiring of the Community Hall are as under: - (A) For Marriage (¢)) For normal 12 hours i.e. from 10.00 A.M. to 10.00 P.M., the charges will be Rs. 10,000/-. di) (For subsequent 12 hours, the charges will be Rs. 12,500/- and for further brackets of 12 hours the charges will be Rs. 15,000/- each). (B) For Sports and other Social Functions (i) For normal 12 hours i.e. from 10.00 A.M. to 10.00 P.M., the charges will be Rs. 7,500/-. (ii) | (For subsequent 12 hours, the charges will be Rs. 10,000/- and for further brackets of 12 hours the charges will be Rs. 12,500/- each.) These rates shall not be revised without the prior approval of the Commissioner of Police, Delhi. For booking the Community Centre/Hall the allottee shall deposit Rs. 5,000/- as security through online mode (UPI or net banking), against receipt, with the Accountant of the concerned District/Unit which shall be refunded to the allottee on handing over the key of Community Centre/Hall to the HAG of the concerned District/Unit after the function/event is over. The hiring charges, inclusive of water and electricity charges, shall be paid in advance through online mode in favour of DCP of the concerned District/Unit, Community Hall Fund. The Community Hall will be allotted for departmental/govt. function free 4 14. 15. 16. 17. of charges, after obtaining the prior approval of President. The Commissioner of Police, Delhi may in very special cases, allot the Community Hall, free of charges. Occupation & Vacation On allotment of the Community Hall, the allottee will collect the key from the ‘Head Assistant of General Branch’ (HAG) of the concerned District/Unit after obtaining the occupation slip. The allottee will vacate the same on completion of the allotment period and hand over the key to the HAG of the concerned District/Unit, who shall check the premises physically. Under no circumstance will the Community Hall be retained for more than the allotment period. Occupation/vacation report will be recorded in Daily Diary or

Consumption of Liquor/Intoxicants No alcoholic drinks or any other intoxicant will be served to the guests attending the marriage ceremony or any function. In case this is noticed the allotment will be cancelled with immediate effect and the local police will be informed. Use of Loud Speakers, Amplifiers, DJ etc. Loud speaker(s), Amplifiers, DJ etc. shall not be played outside the Hall. Loudspeakers, Amplifiers and DJ shall be played only within the audible level and within the time as permissible by the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and Hon’ble National Green. Tribunal. For use of PA systems permission from the competent authority should be obtained in advance. No other temporary structure will be constructed/erected in the Community Hall during the allotment period. Damages Etc. The allottee will be responsible for any breakage or damage to the premises or their fittings. The allottee shall also ensure that the Community Hall area has been got cleaned up by him after the function is over. Any damages/losses caused to Community Hall or its fixtures will be made good by the allottee/licensee. If the allottee does not return the Hall in a cleaned up and ‘as was when allotted’ basis, the security money shall be forfeited, Cleaning/repairs, if any, shall be got done from this security deposit and balance, if any, retained in the Fund. 18. 19. 20. When the allotment is so cancelled, 20% of the charges recovered will be deducted and the balance amount shall be refunded to the allottee/licensee. In case a change in the date is required, the same will be allowed on extra payment of 10% of the charges subject to the availability on receipt of 72 hours written notice and the extra payment in advance.
